## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-10-12: S-1 files form-of TRA as exhibit 10.1
- 2021-11-04: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between The Real Good Food Company, Inc. and the Class B Unit holders of Real Good Foods, LLC (CPG Solutions, Gerard G. Law, Akshay Jagdale, Bryan Freeman as TRA Representative), paying 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups and imputed-interest deductions
- 2021-11-04: 8-K files the executed TRA as exhibit 10.1

#### First Restated and Amended TRA

- 2024-09-20: First Restated and Amended TRA executed concurrent with a financing-and-control transaction (Emblem Investments $60M super-priority loan plus Class C Units convertible into 19.99% of fully diluted equity); expands TRA Holder eligibility to Class C Unit holders (Emblem Investments Fund I, LP, and contingently PMC Financial Services Group) and replaces Bryan Freeman as TRA Representative with an Emblem designee; payment rate, tax-attribute scope, and termination machinery retained
- 2024-09-20: 8-K files the First Restated and Amended TRA as exhibit 10.7

## Explanation

The Real Good Food Company's Up-C IPO on November 4, 2021 created a TRA paying 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups (and imputed-interest deductions) to the Class B Unit holders of Real Good Foods, LLC. The contract was restated on September 20, 2024 concurrent with a financing-and-control transaction in which Emblem Investments extended a $60M super-priority loan and received Class C Units convertible into 19.99% of fully diluted equity (with shareholder approval contemplated to expand to 49.99%); the restated TRA expands the beneficiary set to the new Class C Unit holders and replaces the TRA Representative, but retains the 85% rate and the basis-and-imputed-interest scope. No payments have ever been disclosed: the company has been loss-making post-IPO, the underlying deferred tax assets carry a full valuation allowance, and no TRA liability has been accrued. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the same-contract reasoning for the September 2024 restatement.
